newsitem.title: CANADA: Great Lakes ship engineers ratify deal - union.
newsitem.headline: Great Lakes ship engineers ratify deal - union.

text.p: Ship-board engineers ratified a contract with three Great Lakes shippers on Tuesday, the president of the Canadian Marine Officers Union said Wednesday.

"Our members accepted the tentative agreement. It's a five year contract that expires at the end of May, 2001," CMOU president Richard Vezina said from the group's Montreal office. He referred to a plan that had been viewed as tentative until it was ratified Tuesday.
About 250 CMOU engineers were on strike Thursday to Saturday last week and returned to work Sunday under the CMOU's recommendation they ratify the contract, Vezina said.
The St. Lawrence Seaway is scheduled to open April 2.
The strike affected the Canadian Lake Carriers' Association. The CLCA includes Parrish & Heimbecker Ltd, Algoma Central Marine and N.M. Paterson & Sons Ltd.
